ننتحر (form VIII)
# نَنْتَحِرُ (nantaḥiru) /nan.ta.ħi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# نُنْتَحَرُ (nuntaḥaru) /nun.ta.ħa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# نَنْتَحِرَ (nantaḥira) /nan.ta.ħi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَحَرَ (intaḥara)
# نُنْتَحَرَ (nuntaḥara) /nun.ta.ħa.ra/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
